updates.title: Update banner now shows on the sign-in screen
updates.notes: The 'Install update' banner now appears on the login screen too, not only after you sign in — so if a device ever can't sign in, it can still receive a newer or fixed build in-app instead of installing it by hand. Also includes the v2.6.16 mobile UI polish: the bottom tab bar scrolls smoothly instead of cramming every tab into one row, and the Canaan AI signature on the sign-in screen is smaller so it no longer overshadows the login form. No data or feature changes. Tap Install update, then open the downloaded file to install over your current version.
